exposure: Parent-mediated telehealth version of Program for the Education and Enrichment of Relational Skills (PEERS(r)) for Preschoolers (P4P)
cohort: Young children aged 4-6 years with social challenges (e.g., characteristic of autism spectrum disorder or other developmental disabilities) and their parents/caregivers participated in a telehealth intervention.
finding: The novel telehealth group-based delivery of P4P demonstrated acceptable feasibility and satisfaction, along with increases in parental confidence in social coaching and child social skills.
